project_overview: This Vue.js project appears to manage exam-related processes, including application services, fee details, and result reporting. The application utilizes a layered approach, with core services (ApplicationServices.vue) and supporting components (e.g., ExamFormSubmission.vue) interacting through Router navigation. The structure suggests a modular design, potentially employing a layout component (defaultLayout.vue, spLayout.vue) for common UI elements.

layers.description: Handles user interaction and UI rendering.
Contains the core logic and processes for managing exam data.

macro_trends.title: High-Level Utility Import Risks
macro_trends.description: Several lower-level Vue components (uploadFile.vue, uploadProgessFile.vue) are imported directly into higher-level components like ApplicationServices.vue. This creates a potential dependency chain vulnerability and makes the higher-level components reliant on specific utility implementations, hindering maintainability and potentially introducing complex side effects.

macro_trends.title: Router Dependent Components
macro_trends.description: A significant number of Vue components rely solely on Router navigation for functionality. This concentrates logic within the Router, potentially leading to a single point of failure and reducing the modularity of the application.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The ExamFormSubmission.vue component, coupled with its Router navigation to FeeDetails.vue and Transactions.vue, represents a core workflow for handling exam submissions. This workflow likely integrates with backend services for data persistence and processing.

key_workflows.name: Result Reporting Workflow
key_workflows.description: The ResultPage.vue and viewMarksheet.vue components, dependent on ApplicationServices.vue via Router navigation, highlight a key workflow for generating and presenting exam results. This workflow likely interfaces with scoring and grading systems.
